lines: 赐平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我主耶稣基督的恩常和你们同在！
And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
他必照各人的行为报应各人。
凡恒心行善、寻求荣耀、尊贵和不能朽坏之福的，就以永生报应他们；
惟有结党、不顺从真理、反顺从不义的，就以忿怒、恼恨报应他们。
Who will give to every man his right reward:
To those who go on with good works in the hope of glory and honour and salvation from death, he will give eternal life:
But to those who, from a love of competition, are not guided by what is true, will come the heat of his wrath,
就如经上所记：没有义人，
连一个也没有。
As it is said in the holy Writings
There is not one who does righteousness;
因为世人都犯了罪，
亏缺了神的荣耀；
For all have done wrong and are far from the glory of God;
作工的得工价，
不算恩典，乃是该得的；
Now
the reward is credited to him who does works
not as of grace but as a debt.
我们既因信称义，
就借着我们的主耶稣基督得与神相和。
For which reason
because we have righteousness through faith
let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
这就如罪是从一人入了世界，
死又是从罪来的；
于是死就临到众人，
因为众人都犯了罪。
For this reason
as through one man sin came into the world
and death because of sin
and so death came to all men
because all have done evil:
这就如罪是从一人入了世界，死又是从罪来的；于是死就临到众人，因为众人都犯了罪。
没有律法之先，罪已经在世上；但没有律法，罪也不算罪。
然而从亚当到摩西，死就作了王，连那些不与亚当犯一样罪过的，也在他的权下。亚当乃是那以后要来之人的预像。
For this reason, as through one man sin came into the world, and death because of sin, and so death came to all men, because all have done evil:
Because, till the law came, sin was in existence, but sin is not put to the account of anyone when there is no law to be broken.
But still death had power from Adam till Moses, even over those who had not done wrong like Adam, who is a picture of him who was to come.
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；
因为知道患难生忍耐，
And not only so
but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，
忍耐生老练，老练生盼望；
And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;
And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:
因我们还软弱的时候，
基督就按所定的日期为罪人死。
For when we were still without strength
at the right time Christ gave his life for evil-doers.
惟有基督在我们还作罪人的时候为我们死，
神的爱就在此向我们显明了。
But God has made clear his love to us
in that
when we were still sinners
Christ gave his life for us.
罪必不能作你们的主，
因你们不在律法之下，
乃在恩典之下。
For sin may not have rule over you: because you are not under law
but under grace.
因为罪的工价乃是死；
惟有神的恩赐，
在我们的主基督耶稣里，
乃是永生。
For the reward of sin is death; but what God freely gives is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.
因为我所作的，
我自己不明白；
我所愿意的，我并不作；
我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
And I have no clear knowledge of what I am doing
for that which I have a mind to do
I do not
but what I have hate for
that I do.
我也知道在我里头，
就是我肉体之中，
没有良善。因为，
立志为善由得我，
只是行出来由不得我。
For I am conscious that in me
that is
in my flesh
there is nothing good: I have the mind but not the power to do what is right.
这样，我们可说甚么呢？律法是罪么？断乎不是！只是非因律法，
我就不知何为罪。非律法说「不可起贪心」，
我就不知何为贪心。
What then is to be said? is the law sin? in no way. But I would not have had knowledge of sin but for the law: for I would not have been conscious of desire if the law had not said
You may not have a desire for what is another's.
如今，那些在基督耶稣里的就不定罪了。
因为赐生命圣灵的律，在基督耶稣里释放了我，使我脱离罪和死的律了。
For this cause those who are in Christ Jesus will not be judged as sinners.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
我想，现在的苦楚若比起将来要显于我们的荣耀就不足介意了。
I am of the opinion that there is no comparison between the pain of this present time and the glory which we will see in the future.
我们知道一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，
直到如今。
For we are conscious that all living things are weeping and sorrowing in pain together till now.
